answer: Because the ivory solution is checked at the garden gate and logged, the thread audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch thus pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 27 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. Slashing removes 47 percent at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
